  Readable gloss: "Jattir was a town in the hill country of Judah, assigned to the Levites as one of their cities. David sent spoils there after his victory over the Amalekites, suggesting it was a friendly town that had supported him during his fugitive years. Ancient sources identify it with a village about twenty miles from Eleutheropolis, possibly modern 'Attir located between Hebron and Beersheba, though the identification isn't certain."

  Sense 1: ""
